capture: The unchanged Python application passed all 1,083 original tests under read-only instrumentation. Original-only additional captures cover effective validation, fabricated retrieval and protocol boundaries. All expected values were frozen before native comparison.
fixture_scope: 1653 non-retrieval effective SDK calls, 6 resources, 34 prompts, 842 retrieval cases plus 3 large-catalogue provenance cases and 1,175 JSON-RPC replies across 34 sessions. Complete results/refusals are compared, with only the identities and provenance allowances in NATIVE.md. Additional negative schema, extension and CLI assertions are in boundary_contracts.rs. This does not assert every original test is covered.
refreeze: Refrozen against the Python server at the base above. Python's delta since the first capture is get_data_freshness, its scope line and instructions, the lodgment source_checked date (2026-10-28), one question in evaluation/questions.xml and conformance schema 2. Transforms were named and counted, the scoring cases re-captured from tool_selection.py, and freshness-contracts.json captured over stdio from the Python server. oracle_sha256 records the first capture's raw files, which are not in this repository. Every differing path was in a named category of main's changes, reviewed identity leaves were kept, and 143 calls from main's new and changed tests and independent ABN/ACN probes were added from the Python server's own replies.
